thread:
leo: Heads-up — seeing a burst of pod evictions from gpu-spot-us-west-2 over the last 20m. CA didn't bring fallback nodes up fast enough.

leo: Symptoms: pods stuck Pending -> Terminated, jobs retrying, high queue length.

leo: snippet from events:
```
Normal  Scheduled  Pod scheduled to node gpu-spot-abc123  10m
Warning  FailedScheduling  8m  default-scheduler  0/12 nodes are available: 3 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 9 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
Warning  Evicted  5m  kubelet  The node was preempted
```

infra-bot: autoscaler: scale-up detected for nodepool=gpu-spot-us-west-2, requested=8, available=0, fallbackDelay=120s

maya: @leo thanks, can you paste the pod yaml or job id? did CA return any errors? :eyes:

leo: job id rwd-infer-2026-11, minimal pod yaml below:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: rwd-infer-2026-11
spec:
  containers:
  - name: infer
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```

aj: We bumped cluster-autoscaler to respect Spot pools but the fallback on-demand pool has min=0. If spot drops fast CA waits for scale-up policy which is linear. Might be hitting provider rate limits too.

sam: Also saw increased regional preemptions in us-west-2 earlier — GCE/AWS posted maintenance events. Could be correlated.

caroline: Short-term: we should pin a tiny warm on-demand pool (gpu-fallback-us-west-ondemand min=1) so critical jobs can land. Mid-term: adjust CA scaleUpRate and add a reactive fallback policy.

maya: I'll run a controlled change: set gpu-fallback-us-west-ondemand minNodes=1 and CA maxNodeProvisionRate=20 for that pool, then observe for 30m. Creating ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321> (INF-4321).

aj: FYI we also need to update quota request with cloud team if we keep a warm node — cost delta but saves retries.

leo: Sounds good. Can we add a tiny readiness probe to pre-warm model cache on fallback nodes? avoids cold-start latency.

maya: yep, will add init container to the fallback pool node template to pull models. experiment branch: git@repo:redwood/infra#ephemeral-warm-fallback

infra-bot: task created: INF-4321 assigned to maya, severity=low, priority=high

caroline: After maya's change, let's run a 3h stress window and track failed pod rate, avg pod start time, retry count. Use console dashboard: /dashboards/gpu-scaling/overview.

maya: On it. I'll post update in 30m and escalate if we still see >5% eviction-related failures. :thumbsup:

leo: thanks — appreciate the quick loop.
